values.note: Menominee County: electric sites $30 a night, primitive $20; $10 non-refundable reservation fee per site per reservation. Vehicle entrance $5 a day or a $20 annual pass. One rate for residents and non-residents.

fees.source: https://www.menomineecountyparks.com/parks/camping/kleinke_park/ ('ELECTRIC SITES: $30 PER NIGHT', 'PRIMITIVE SITES: $20 PER NIGHT', 'RESERVATION FEE: $10 PER SITE PER RESERVATION (NON-REFUNDABLE)', 'DAILY VEHICLE ENTRANCE FEE: $5 PER DAY', 'ANNUAL VEHICLE ENTRANCE PASS: $20 PER VEHICLE'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.menomineecountyparks.com/parks/camping/kleinke_park/ ('30 electric campsites that all have 20/30/50 AMP service'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.menomineecountyparks.com/parks/camping/kleinke_park/ ('a heated shower building with flush toilets, a vault toilet centrally located in the park, and a camper sanitation station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online on Menominee County Parks' own reservation site. Cancel 7+ days out for a refund (as credit) less the $10 fee; nothing back inside 7 days. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.menomineecountyparks.com/parks/camping/kleinke_park/ (county reservation site 'Find A Campsite', cancellation policy, check-in/out times), read 2026-10-22

note: Menominee County park, 27 acres on M-35 along Green Bay with over a quarter mile of sandy beach; 13 of the electric sites sit right on the shore, and there are primitive sites as well. The county's Stoney Point boat launch is 10 miles south. --Claude
summary: County reservation page read: confirmed $30 electric ($20 primitive), $10 reservation fee, one rate for everyone, plus a $5/day vehicle entrance (added as fees.entrance), season May 1 - Oct 31, 20/30/50-amp at all 30 electric sites, showers/flush/vault toilets/sanitation station (all now manual), reservable online on the county's own site. Not stated: water or sewer at sites, number of primitive sites (sites.count 30 = electric only, left). Note cleaned of hookup, facility, season, price and booking text.
